learning_objective: 🎯 To understand how our view of the world grows larger as we learn, grow, and step out of our comfort zones!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When the little bird was inside its egg, it thought the whole world was small, round, and made of a pale blue shell. It felt very safe inside.
After hatching, the bird saw its nest made of straw. Now it believed the world was just a cozy, warm bowl built by its mother.
As the bird grew, it hopped onto a branch. It looked around and decided that the world was actually made of green leaves and tall trees.
Finally, the bird spread its wings and flew high into the sky. It realized the world is wonderfully vast and full of endless possibilities!

fun_activity.title: 🎭 Draw the World!
fun_activity.instructions: Imagine you are a tiny ant living under a rock. Draw a picture of what you think the whole world looks like from down there!

quick_recap: ⭐ The bird first thought the world was just its tiny, pale blue egg.
⭐ Next, it believed the world was only its warm straw nest.
⭐ When it stepped out, it thought the world was made of green leaves.
⭐ Flying away taught the bird that the world is huge and amazing.
